items.text: Kansas City (early week): QB Patrick Mahomes (right/throwing elbow sprain in Wk9, MRI showed no major injury) day-to-day; Reid: 'more positive news than negative', reassess Wednesday, practice may be limited; Justin Fields backup. Day-to-day - WR Xavier Worthy (hamstring), RT Jaylon Moore (ankle). TBD - CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder), DT Peter Woods (neck), both inactive Wk9. IR - WR Tyquan Thornton, CB L'Jarius Sneed, LT Josh Simmons (eligible Wk11). Mahomes expected to start.
items.source: ESPN (Reid: Mahomes day-to-day with elbow injury, Nov 9)

items.text: Atlanta (early week, 3-6 after loss to CIN in Madrid): TBD - WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring, may miss multiple games). Monitor - LB Divine Deablo (forearm fracture, aggravated late Wk9), WR Olamide Zaccheaus (concussion check, returned), EDGE James Pearce Jr. (back). IR - RB Brian Robinson Jr., DE Samson Ebukam, DT Da'Shawn Hand. S Jessie Bates traded; DeMarcco Hellams starts at S. Michael Penix Jr. expected to start.
items.source: AP via La Nacion (Falcons after loss to Bengals, Nov 9)
